title: apps/desktop: Tauri shell ships CSP disabled with whole-home-directory fs scope
description:
apps/desktop Tauri hardening (CSP + fs scope). Implemented:
- tauri.conf.json app.security.csp set from null to a restrictive policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' (no unsafe-inline/eval, no remote scripts) — blocks injected/remote scripts while Ruffle WASM still runs; img/media data:+blob:, style-src unsafe-inline, worker/child blob:, connect-src ws:/wss:+ipc: for collab+Tauri IPC. Added a looser devCsp for Vite HMR (localhost:1420, unsafe-inline/eval).
- capabilities/default.json fs scope narrowed from fs:scope-home-recursive (~ whole home) to user content dirs only: document/download/desktop/picture/audio/video (recursive). Excludes ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config, browser profiles. All fs access already goes through native open/save dialogs.
- gen/schemas/capabilities.json (tracked, tauri-build generated) updated to mirror.
- docs/00-overview-and-architecture.md: new 'Desktop shell security' section documenting the CSP + fs scope + manual verification steps.

Verification: JSON well-formed (python json.load all 3). Full ordered build 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0. 'pnpm --filter @flash/desktop typecheck' exit 0. Cannot build/run the Tauri binary in this headless env; manual runtime verification (tauri dev/build: no CSP violations, Ruffle plays, collab connects, open/save/publish under scoped dirs) documented in docs. Follow-up noted: arbitrary out-of-scope file locations would need dialog-granted per-file runtime scope.
